## Welcome

I am a Predoctoral Research Assistant to **[Professor Clément Imbert](https://sites.google.com/site/clemimbert/)** in the Department of Economics at **Sciences Po**.

I hold an MRes in Economics from Sciences Po and a BA in Economics from **Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST)**, Ghana.

I am a two-time **[Mastercard Foundation Scholar](https://mastercardfdn.org/en/)**, having received the scholarship for both my undergraduate and master's studies.

My research interests lie in **development economics, environmental economics, public economics, and political economy**, with an empirical focus on Sub-Saharan Africa.
